before: A take-back of a party's column removed the width records the column lent from other cells, so a cell that lent width to the column kept its width from before the column, also when a later column had taken part of the column's cell. The cells then held more than the grid.
after: A take-back keeps those width records apart on the cell (takenBackLendings), where they draw nothing and hold no card, and compose gives the width back by them as for a rejected column, as the editor alone withdraws its own pending column by rejecting it.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the manifest fields and the Yjs format do not change: the new item label is model state that every client rebuilds from the same take-back change, and a fold drops it, as it writes no cell of a taken-back column. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
